## "date_metadata_updated_ars"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Timestamp of the type: ISO 8601:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
Timestamp for when an asset's metadata was last updated.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Populated by ARS when the first change to an assets metadata is registered.

**Updated where and when:**  
After each update to an assets metadata in ARS.

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
None

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
